notes: arsenal/media/probe.py: one ffprobe read of a file's facts (streams, audio track names, keyframe interval, OBS encoder, recorded time, kind), remembered as a sidecar under <state>/sidecars/<id>.json; never beside or inside the original. ~110 ms cold on a 33-min 2.4 GB recording, ~3 ms from the sidecar; the full keyframe index adds ~1 s. py -m arsenal.media probe <video>.
